title: Chapter 217 Terrifying Xiao Clan
content:
Chapter 217 Terrifying Xiao Clan

Immediately, Lu Xue's face gradually calmed down.

"My name is Lu Xue. It was your Xiao clan who invited you to help solve your Xiao clan's difficulties."

Lu Xue returned the token and spoke slowly.

Suddenly, the field was silent.

The two men with long hair stared at each other, their expressions changing.

"Stop kidding, just you?"

The woman in orange was also a little unbelievable.

"Girl, I admit that you are indeed a bit unusual, but I, Xiao clan, are also the ancient family, after all."

The words were not finished.

But the meaning is very obvious. My Xiao clan is a dignified ancient family. Will you ask an immortal king to help?

Hearing this, Lu Xue said in a faint voice: "What is the situation of your Xiao clan now? Don't you still know?"

"Besides, I'm not bad at all, okay."

The three of them did not refute this.

After all, two of them had just suffered a loss at Lu Xue's hands.

After a long silence, the woman in orange slowly said, "You follow me."

Immediately, the woman in orange turned around and headed towards the depths of the mountain.

The two men also trembled and disappeared directly.

At this time, Lu Xue suddenly discovered that the fog around had become very faint, and the deeper it reached the mountains, the fainter it became.

Seeing this, Lu Xue did not hesitate and directly followed Ao Qing.

The deeper he walked, Lu Xue's face became more and more surprised.

Deep in the mountains, there are people from the Xiao clan.

And there are quite a few.

Suddenly, Lu Xue suddenly realized that the Xiao people who had entered here were not dead.

Then why don’t they go out?

With this question in mind, Lu Xue continued to follow the woman in orange toward the depths.

"Huh? The fairy spirit here is quite strong."

As he walked, Lu Xue suddenly said.

Hearing this, the woman in orange was a little stunned. What does it mean is quite rich.

After living for so many years, she has never seen any place in the fairyland that is stronger than the fairy energy here.

"Hey, where are you going to take me?"

Lu Xue asked.

Hearing this, the woman in orange said, "Take you to see my senior of Xiao clan."

After saying this, the woman in orange stopped talking.

After a while, Lu Xue followed the woman in orange to a towering mountain.

I saw several scattered stone buildings standing on the mountain.

Lu Xue was slightly stunned and suddenly realized that the power of the rules here was so strong that she could not even fly here in the Immortal King Realm.

There is really mystery everywhere here.

But Lu Xue is confident that everything will be revealed in no time.

"I'll take you up there."

At this time, the woman in orange was suddenly said.

Immediately, the woman in orange grabbed Lu Xue's hand and flew directly towards the stone house at the highest point of the mountain.

"After a moment, they will ask you what you ask, just answer."

Hearing this, Lu Xue was silent for a moment.

“I have a lot of questions, too.”

"We will answer it for you."

Hearing this, Lu Xue nodded.

Soon, the two of them came to the stone building. At this moment, Lu Xue was surprised to find that the stone house was so huge. Standing in front of the stone house, it was as small as an ant.

Buzz —

At this time, the stone door in front of me suddenly opened slowly.

"let's go."

Xiao Yin said beside him.

Immediately, the two walked side by side into the stone house.

As soon as he entered the stone house, Lu Xue was shocked again. In the entire huge stone house, there was only a large stone table and a stone bench lined up in front of the stone table.

At this time, there were seven people sitting in front of the stone table.

The seven people had different expressions, but the same thing was that they were all looking at Lu Xue.

"Sir, I have brought you guys."

Xiao Yin said to the people.

Then Xiao Yin sat at the stone table.

Seeing this, Lu Xue did not hesitate and followed Xiao Yin to the seat beside Xiao Yin.

This action made the seven people in the stone house slightly stunned.

"You said, are you sent by the Xiao tribe outside to solve the ancestral problem?"

At this time, a Xiao tribe with a slightly young face spoke to Lu Xue.

Hearing this, Lu Xue waved her hand.

Seeing this, the Xiao tribe frowned slightly.

"Then you broke in by yourself?"

Suddenly, the atmosphere in the stone house became depressed instantly, and everyone stared at Lu Xue tightly, as if they were about to eat Lu Xue raw in the next second.

At this time, Lu Xue coughed lightly and said in a low voice: "Correction, I was not sent by you Xiao people, I was invited."

These words made everyone present stunned again.

The seven people had different expressions and didn't know what they were thinking.

"Little girl, can you tell me how the Xiao clan is doing now?"

A gray-haired old man showed a kind smile and smiled at Lu Xue.

Hearing this, Lu Xue said directly: "It's very bad."

Suddenly, everyone's expressions became solemn.

At this time, Lu Xue continued, "You Xiao clan is now suffering from internal and external troubles. Simply put, there is no strong man in your Xiao clan who can show off. There are many forces outside who can see your Xiao clan outside. Resources.”

"I'm afraid that in a short while, your Xiao clan will be destroyed."

Lu Xue's calm voice sounded from inside the stone house.

It can be seen from the naked eye that all the Xiao people present had turned extremely ugly.

"They are so brave!"

With a bang, a member of the Xiao tribe with a scar on his face slapped the table and stood up.

A terrifying murderous intent slowly overflowed from his body.

And this person's aura was also exposed without any concealment.

He is actually a peak powerhouse in the Immortal Emperor Realm!

At this time, his face was ferocious and his temples were bulging, and he was obviously really angry.

"Xiao Yong."

The gray-haired old man spoke.

Hearing this, Xiao Yong sat down with pride, but his face still looked angry.

"Can't you go out?"

At this time, Lu Xue expressed her own questions.

She saw that it was not that the Xiao clan did not have strong people, but that the real strong people were all in this ancestral land. As time accumulates, there are more and more powerful people in the ancestral land, while the Xiao clan outside is becoming more and more powerful people. weak.

Until now, it is almost exterminated.

Hearing Lu Xue’s questions, everyone in the Xiao clan lowered their heads and their faces were low.

"Little girl, if we could go out, we would have gone out long ago. How could we let those little ones see me Xiao clan?"

One of the beautiful women smiled bitterly.

"Yes, if we could go out, we would have gone out long ago."

The old man with gray hair sighed, and a few wrinkles were added to his wrinkled face.

"Why?"

Lu Xue frowned.

On the way here, Lu Xue didn't notice anything. At most, there was a little fog, but Lu Xue didn't believe that the fog could trap the group of strong people in front of her.

At this moment, Lu Xue had already seen that in the entire stone house, except for himself, there was no one with cultivation below the peak of the Immortal Emperor Realm.

In other words, there are at least eight peak powerhouses in this stone house.

What is this concept?

The power of the Xiao clan can sweep across the other three ancient clans.

But now, the Xiao clan outside is living such a miserable life.
